external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Founded in 1960 by Robert C. Lurie, the RC Lurie Company (RCL) is a full-service manufacturer’s representative for lighting and controls products and services across the state of Arizona. We are one of only two agencies to have represented Lithonia Lighting (now Acuity Brands) since the company began utilizing outside representatives. Today, RCL represents a wide range of other manufacturers, giving us the ability to meet the product needs of even the most demanding designs.
